Token decimals, set to 18 in constructor.
Total token supply, set to 10**33 in constructor.
Mapping of address to token balance; mutated by transfer/transferFrom/constructor.
Nested mapping owner=>spender=>amount allowance; mutated by approve/transferFrom/approveAndCall.
Current owner address in Owned, set from msg.sender in constructor.
Pending owner address used by two-step ownership transfer.
SafeMath addition helper returning a + b with overflow require.
SafeMath subtraction helper returning a - b with underflow require.
SafeMath multiplication helper returning a * b with overflow require.
SafeMath division helper returning a / b with divide-by-zero require.
Owned constructor assigning owner = msg.sender.
Owner-only function setting pending newOwner.
Accept pending ownership; requires msg.sender == newOwner and updates owner/newOwner.
Constructor that mints the whole supply to a fixed address and sets metadata.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Returns balances[tokenOwner].
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeAdd/safeSub and emits Transfer.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' and decrements allowance using safeSub/safeAdd.
Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Approves spender then calls external receiveApproval on the spender contract.
Payable fallback that immediately reverts to reject ETH.
Owner-only function that forwards any ERC20 tokens held by the contract to the owner via external call.
External caller address used for balances indexing, allowance ownership, owner and newOwner checks.
Unsigned addition a + b inside safeAdd; overflow guarded by require(c >= a).
Unsigned subtraction a - b inside safeSub; underflow guarded by require(b <= a).
Unsigned multiplication a * b inside safeMul; overflow checked by division.
Unsigned division a / b inside safeDiv; zero divisor guarded by require(b > 0).
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) in approveAndCall that hands control to an arbitrary contract.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) in transferAnyERC20Token to an attacker-supplied contract.
Parameter 'to' of transfer(): destination address.
Parameter 'tokens' of transfer(): amount moved from msg.sender.
Parameter 'spender' of approve(): allowance beneficiary.
Parameter 'tokens' of approve(): allowance amount value.
Parameter 'from' of transferFrom(): debited account.
Parameter 'to' of transferFrom(): credited account.
Parameter 'tokens' of transferFrom(): amount moved.
Parameter 'spender' of approveAndCall(): callee contract, address of external call target.
Parameter 'tokens' of approveAndCall(): allowance amount and value forwarded to the callback.
Parameter 'data' of approveAndCall(): arbitrary bytes forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
Parameter '_newOwner' of transferOwnership(): pending owner address.

edges.reason: msg.sender indexes balances for the debited account in transfer.
msg.sender is the allowance owner key in approve.
msg.sender indexes allowed[from][msg.sender] in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the allowance owner key and is forwarded as 'from' to receiveApproval.
acceptOwnership authorises via require(msg.sender == newOwner).
Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against owner before transferOwnership executes.
acceptOwnership overwrites owner with newOwner after the sender check.
Owned constructor writes the owner state variable.
transferOwnership stores the pending owner into newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
LokiInu constructor sets _totalSupply to 10**33.
LokiInu constructor mints the full supply into balances of a hard-coded address.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply state variable.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
transfer writes balances for msg.sender and recipient.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom writes balances for from and to.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
transferAnyERC20Token sends the pulled tokens to the owner address.
safeAdd executes the unsigned addition a + b.
safeSub executes the unsigned subtraction a - b.
safeMul executes the unsigned multiplication a * b.
safeDiv executes the unsigned division a / b.
transfer delegates the sender debit to safeSub.
transfer delegates the recipient credit to safeAdd.
transferFrom uses safeSub for balance and allowance decrements.
transferFrom uses safeAdd for the recipient credit.
approveAndCall transfers control to the external receiveApproval call.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external ERC20 transfer to an arbitrary tokenAddress.
Untrusted spender contract regains control during receiveApproval and can re-enter allowance-manipulating functions.
External receiveApproval can re-enter approveAndCall before the first invocation returns.
transfer 'to' address is the credited key in balances.
transfer 'tokens' amount flows into safeSub/safeAdd balance updates.
approve 'spender' is the inner key of the allowed mapping.
approve 'tokens' value is stored as the allowance.
transferFrom 'from' address is debited in balances.
transferFrom 'to' address is credited in balances.
transferFrom 'tokens' amount is subtracted from the allowance.
approveAndCall 'spender' is the allowance key and the external call target.
approveAndCall 'tokens' value is stored as allowance and forwarded to the callback.
Attacker-controlled 'data' bytes are forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
transferOwnership '_newOwner' parameter is written to the newOwner state variable.

Spender parameter is only used to index allowed inside approve.
Amount parameter is only stored into allowed inside approve.
From-address parameter is only used inside transferFrom balance and allowance updates.
To-address parameter is only used inside transferFrom balance updates.
Amount parameter is only used by transferFrom's safeSub/safeAdd calls.
Spender parameter is the allowance key and external call target of approveAndCall.
Amount parameter is stored as allowance and forwarded in the external call.
Opaque data parameter is passed straight through to the external receiveApproval call.
